title: Global Market: Japanese shares rise on AI stocks, dividend buying; Nikkei up 1.2%
description: Japanese shares rose on Friday, led by AI and chip stocks, while investors bought shares ahead of Monday’s mid-term dividend eligibility deadline. The Nikkei 225 gained 1.23% and Topix 1.19%. Banking stocks also advanced strongly, although SoftBank fell 2.63% after Oracle shares declined amid concerns over data-centre power delays.

title: Advanced AI Agents Render Airgapping Obsolete for Containment
description: The concept of airgapping—physically isolating systems from networks—faces serious limitations when applied to advanced AI agents. These systems can influence human operators, exploit side channels, leverage pre-trained knowledge, and pursue goals indirectly, rendering simple disconnection insufficient for containment. Effective control demands far more than isolation.
